title: HR$^{2}$-KILO: A High-Rate, Robust, Kinematic-Inertial-LiDAR Odometry for Humanoid Robots
title_zh: HR$^{2}$-KILO：一种用于人形机器人的高速率、鲁棒的运动学-惯性-激光雷达里程计
abstract: In this letter, we present a high-rate and robust multi-sensor fusion framework for state estimation of humanoid robots, named HR<inline-formula><tex-math notation="LaTeX">$^{2}$</tex-math></inline-formula>-KILO. To handle the inherently high-dynamic characteristics of humanoid robots, the proposed framework tightly couples the measurements from the joint encoder, inertial sensor, and LiDAR. We estimate states within the error-state Kalman filter, incorporating the pointwise update strategy, IMU measurement model, and multiple leg kinematic information. Moreover, acceleration fluctuations, foot positions, and the history map are utilized for online contact detection without any contact sensors. The overall system fully utilizes the available multi-source information, making it compact and easy to deploy. Extensive experiments are conducted both on the public dataset and in the real world, including different humanoid robots and diverse scenarios. The results demonstrate that HR<inline-formula><tex-math notation="LaTeX">$^{2}$</tex-math></inline-formula>-KILO achieves extremely high rate output and lower drift compared to state-of-the-art LiDAR-inertial(-kinematic) methods. To contribute to the community, the source code and the multi-sensor humanoid dataset are released.
abstract_zh: 本文提出了一种用于人形机器人状态估计的高速、鲁棒的多传感器融合框架，命名为HR$^{2}$-KILO。为应对人形机器人固有的高动态特性，该框架紧耦合了关节编码器、惯性传感器和激光雷达的测量数据。我们在误差状态卡尔曼滤波中估计状态，并融入了逐点更新策略、IMU测量模型以及多腿运动学信息。此外，利用加速度波动、足部位置和历史地图进行在线接触检测，无需任何接触传感器。整个系统充分利用了可用的多源信息，使其紧凑且易于部署。我们在公开数据集和真实世界中进行了大量实验，包括不同的人形机器人和多样化的场景。结果表明，与最先进的激光雷达-惯性(-运动学)方法相比，HR$^{2}$-KILO实现了极高的输出速率和更低的漂移。为贡献于社区，我们发布了源代码和多传感器人形机器人数据集。
tldr_zh: 提出HR$^{2}$-KILO框架，紧耦合多传感器实现人形机器人高速率低漂移状态估计。
cover_zh: 人形机器人高动态难估计？这个框架紧耦合多传感器，速率高漂移低！
